verdict.rationale: The `x-instruction` header lets users give natural-language instructions to extract specific fields (via ReaderLM-v2), and the `x-preset: research` bundle is tailored for AI agents, showing some natural-language-driven operation. However, this is limited to extraction/formatting rather than full natural-language control of the whole reading/search pipeline, and there's no independent corroboration of reliability. Missing for 10: broader NL control across all Reader operations (search, fetch, formatting) and third-party validation that x-instruction works robustly.
